items.text: Is appropriate PPE being worn correctly by all personnel (hard hat, hi-vis, footwear, eye protection)?
Is site access controlled, with sign-in/out and up-to-date inductions?
Are visitors escorted and briefed on site rules before entering active areas?
Are current RAMS in place and available for all works being undertaken?
Are Permits to Work (hot works, confined space, etc.) correctly issued and displayed?
Are operatives briefed on relevant RAMS/permits before starting work?
Are fire extinguishers in place, in date, and unobstructed?
Are emergency routes and assembly points clear, signed and unobstructed?
Are emergency contact numbers and first aiders clearly displayed?
Are first aid kits fully stocked, in date, and accessible?
Are welfare facilities (toilets, drying rooms, canteen) clean and adequate?
Is a qualified first aider on site and clearly identified?
Is plant/equipment inspected, tagged and in good condition (LOLER/PUWER)?
Are lifting operations properly planned and supervised (lift plans in place)?
Are exclusion zones maintained around moving plant and vehicles?
Is work at height properly planned with suitable access equipment (scaff tags, edge protection)?
Are excavations shored/battered and formally inspected as required?
Are barriers and signage in place around open excavations and edges?
Is electrical equipment PAT tested, tagged and in good condition?
Are hazardous substances (COSHH) stored, labelled correctly, with assessments available?
Are gas cylinders stored upright, secured and segregated correctly?
Is the site clear of trip/slip hazards, with waste managed appropriately?
Are environmental controls in place (spill kits, drainage protection)?
Is GMP-adjacent H&S practice maintained where works are near controlled areas?
